name: Nebius Independence AI factory
summary: Nebius is building what it calls its first gigawatt-scale AI infrastructure project in the US on about 400 acres in eastern Independence, Missouri, near Route 78 and Little Blue Parkway. The project page describes up to 1.2 GW across four buildings built over five to seven years, with 800 MW from Independence Power & Light and 400 MW of possible on-site generation still under evaluation. Nebius bought the land in December 2025, the City Council approved a Chapter 100 incentive in March 2026, and ground was broken in May 2026 with ARCO as general contractor.

location.note: City centroid from the Wikipedia infobox for Independence (s3). The groundbreaking release places the roughly 400-acre site in eastern Independence and the project page puts it at Route 78 and Little Blue Parkway, but no geocoder was used, so the point is the city centroid rather than the site. The city spans Jackson and Clay counties, so no county is given.
